candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is a composite: severe COVID-19 pneumonia + ARDS + pregnancy + V-V ECMO requirement. C001 correctly identifies severe COVID-19 pneumonia, which is the core etiology, but does not specify ARDS (the pulmonary complication driving ECMO), the pregnancy context (27 weeks gestation, a clinically required modifier given the case), or the V-V ECMO support (a defining treatment state explicitly part of the benchmark). These are not redundant details but required components of the full diagnostic object.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures severe COVID-19 pneumonia but omits ARDS, pregnancy context as a required composite component, and V-V ECMO support as a defining clinical state

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis includes treatment modality (V-V ECMO) as a required composite component, which is atypical for a pure diagnostic label but is clinically justified given the ECMO-associated complication (tubular clot on drainage cannula) described in the record.
